source_policy.web_usage_note: Closed environment. Solve only from task.txt and env files.

design_notes: Difficulty is no longer increased by adding more final relationships.
The final diagram is smaller than the production intermediate: 23 entities and 28 relationships.

The added difficulty comes from selecting one effective view profile, resolving same-timestamp revisions, applying precedence, cascading entity exclusions, suppressing one direct shortcut, and using frozen display names and facts.
The original production model must still be resolved correctly before applying the governed view.
Fifteen Grounded VQAs remain, and each checks a compact rational bundle of roughly three to five facts.
The single visual VQA and its exact 0/1/2 rubric are unchanged.
